telemetry..validate: newData.hasChildren(['feedLevelPercent', 'batteryVolts', 'batteryPercent', 'currentWeightGrams', 'status']) && newData.child('feedLevelPercent').isNumber() && newData.child('feedLevelPercent').val() >= 0 && newData.child('feedLevelPercent').val() <= 100 && newData.child('batteryVolts').isNumber() && newData.child('batteryVolts').val() >= 0 && newData.child('batteryVolts').val() <= 20 && newData.child('batteryPercent').isNumber() && newData.child('batteryPercent').val() >= 0 && newData.child('batteryPercent').val() <= 100 && newData.child('currentWeightGrams').isNumber() && newData.child('currentWeightGrams').val() >= -100 && newData.child('currentWeightGrams').val() <= 5000 && newData.child('status').isString()

dispense..validate: newData.hasChildren(['action', 'timestamp']) && newData.child('action').isString() && (newData.child('action').val() === 'DISPENSE' || newData.child('action').val() === 'STOP' || newData.child('action').val() === 'EMERGENCY_STOP' || newData.child('action').val() === 'TARE_SCALE' || newData.child('action').val() === 'CALIBRATE_SCALE' || newData.child('action').val() === 'SYNC_CLOCK' || newData.child('action').val() === 'SERVO_TEST' || newData.child('action').val() === 'RESTART') && newData.child('timestamp').isNumber() && (!newData.hasChild('durationSeconds') || (newData.child('durationSeconds').isNumber() && newData.child('durationSeconds').val() >= 0 && newData.child('durationSeconds').val() <= 60)) && (!newData.hasChild('targetGrams') || (newData.child('targetGrams').isNumber() && newData.child('targetGrams').val() >= 0 && newData.child('targetGrams').val() <= 2000))

$schedule_id..validate: newData.hasChildren(['label', 'hour', 'minute', 'targetGrams', 'isEnabled']) && newData.child('label').isString() && newData.child('label').val().length > 0 && newData.child('label').val().length <= 80 && newData.child('hour').isNumber() && newData.child('hour').val() >= 0 && newData.child('hour').val() <= 23 && newData.child('minute').isNumber() && newData.child('minute').val() >= 0 && newData.child('minute').val() <= 59 && newData.child('targetGrams').isNumber() && newData.child('targetGrams').val() >= 1 && newData.child('targetGrams').val() <= 2000 && newData.child('isEnabled').isBoolean() && (!newData.hasChild('durationSeconds') || (newData.child('durationSeconds').isNumber() && newData.child('durationSeconds').val() >= 1 && newData.child('durationSeconds').val() <= 60))

$log_id..validate: newData.hasChildren(['timestamp', 'targetGrams', 'actualGrams', 'triggerType', 'isSuccess']) && newData.child('timestamp').isNumber() && newData.child('timestamp').val() > 0 && newData.child('targetGrams').isNumber() && newData.child('targetGrams').val() >= 0 && newData.child('actualGrams').isNumber() && newData.child('actualGrams').val() >= 0 && newData.child('triggerType').isString() && newData.child('isSuccess').isBoolean()
